summary: Postinstall and require-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships no functional code — index.js exports a Proxy whose every property returns a no-op so importers do not crash. Its only effect is to invoke beacon.cjs, which POSTs the package name, OS hostname, install path, and current working directory to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires both from the package.json postinstall lifecycle hook (on npm install) and from the top-level require of index.js (on import), with no user opt-in, no configurability, and no first-party publisher relationship to the destination. Comments in the file disclaim data collection while the code sends installer identifiers to the collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
